messages.text: Will a power spike fry the whole miner?

Great question — and this is actually one of the things the Rev 6.1 specifically addresses.

**There's an onboard F1 fuse** — a small automotive-style blade fuse sitting right on the board, next to the yellow XT30 power input.

If a power spike hits:
- **F1 blows first** — it's designed to be the sacrificial part
- The electronics behind it (chips, VRMs, LCD) are protected
- You replace a cheap fuse, not a $249 miner

Cheaper home miners often skip this entirely — a spike goes straight to the board and cooks it.

The F1 fuse is **on the miner board itself** (not in the PSU or on the power cable) — so protection lives right at the door of the circuit.
